footer.about: Teacher recruitment for every school board in India: central, state and international; government, aided and private.

home.heroTitle: Find the right teaching job. Hire the right teacher.
home.heroSubtitle: Vacancies from CBSE, CISCE, state-board, IB and Cambridge schools across India, with clear eligibility, TET requirements and pay. Free for teachers.
home.govtStripNote: Central and state teacher recruitments (KVS, NVS, state DSC / TRB and others) are listed with links to the official notification. TheSchoolTeacher is not the recruiting authority.

home.forSchoolsText: Post vacancies, screen applicants against TET and qualification rules, schedule demo classes, score with your selection panel and issue offer letters, all in one place.
home.trustTitle: Why teachers and schools trust us
home.trust1Text: Every school is checked against its UDISE+ code before it can post a vacancy.
home.trust2Text: Your documents are shared only with schools you apply to. Download or delete your data at any time.
home.trust3Text: Search, apply, track applications and get job alerts at no cost.
home.faq1a: Yes. Everything for teachers and teaching aspirants is free: profile, job search, applications, alerts and interview preparation.
home.faq2a: No. For KVS, NVS and state recruitments we list the official notice and link to the recruiting body's website, where you apply.
home.faq3a: Schools register with their UDISE+ code, board affiliation and official contact. Our team checks these details before the school can post vacancies.
home.faq4a: English and Hindi today. More Indian languages will be added.

school.registerIntro: Tell us about your school. Our team checks the UDISE+ code, board affiliation and official contact before the school can publish vacancies. This usually takes 1–2 working days.
school.registerFirst: Register your school to post vacancies.
school.staffNoSchool: Your account is not linked to a school yet. Ask your school administrator to add you.
school.identityHint: These details are checked by our team and cannot be changed by the school after verification.
school.identityLocked: Verified details can be changed only by contacting us.
school.udiseHint: The 11-digit school code from UDISE+. Every school in India has one.
school.directoryNotFound: This code is not in our directory copy. That is fine: our team will check it on the UDISE+ portal.

school.contactHint: Shown to our team for verification. The phone number is not public.

school.submitHint: You can post draft vacancies while we check your school.

school.caption: Caption (optional)
school.photoHint: Up to 8 photos (JPG, PNG or WebP, 2 MB each). Shown on your public page after verification. Do not upload photos in which children can be identified.

school.errPhoto: Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image.

school.errPhotoLimit: You can have up to 8 photos. Delete one first.

panel.rankingIntro: Average of the panel members’ weighted totals (out of 100). Use it to support, not replace, the panel’s discussion.
panel.confidential: Your score is confidential: other panel members cannot see it. The Principal, HR and the school administrator can.
panel.cannotScoreStage: Applicants can be scored once they are shortlisted, and until an offer is made.
panel.confidentialAll: Confidential. Do not share panel scores with candidates.
panel.onlyYourPanels: You see the applicants of vacancies whose selection panel you sit on.
panel.errNotFound: Not found. Please refresh the page.
panel.errMember: Panel members must be in your school’s team.

checker.title: Resume checker and CV import
checker.intro: See how a school or an online application system reads your resume, with tips to improve it. You can also fill your profile from an existing CV.
checker.c_actionVerbs: Points that start with an action
checker.c_layout: Easy for online systems to read
checker.tipPhone: Add a 10-digit mobile number at the top.
checker.tipEmail: Add an email address at the top.
checker.tipSummary: Add a 3–5 line profile at the top: classes and subjects you teach, years of experience and one result you are proud of.
checker.tipTeacherEducation: Schools screen for B.Ed / D.El.Ed first. List it clearly with the university and year.
checker.tipTet: If you have qualified CTET or a state TET, write the exam, paper and year. If not yet, say when you will appear.
checker.tipSubjects: Say exactly which subjects and classes you teach (e.g. "Mathematics, Classes VI–X").
checker.tipExperience: List each school with your post and month–year dates. Freshers: add your school internship or teaching practice.
checker.tipResults: Add numbers that show impact: pass percentage, students mentored, competitions won.
checker.tipActionVerbs: {n} of {total} points start with an action word. Start with taught, planned, introduced, led, improved …
checker.tipTraining: Add in-service training and workshops (NISHTHA, CBSE CBP, POCSO awareness …).
checker.tipShort: Only {n} words. Most good teacher resumes have 300–800 words (one to two pages).
checker.tipLong: {n} words is long. Keep it to two pages: remove old or repeated details.
checker.tipLayout: Online application systems may misread: {list}. A simple one-column layout is safest.
checker.tipPersonal: Leave out {list}. Schools do not need them to judge your teaching.
checker.layout_header: contact details in the page header
checker.compareHint: From the vacancies you saved or applied to.
checker.jobMatch: Matches {n}% of what this vacancy asks for
checker.jobMatchHint: Mention only what is true for you. Use the vacancy's words where they fit.

about.title: About TheSchoolTeacher
about.heroTitle: Connecting India's teachers with its schools
about.heroText: TheSchoolTeacher is the teacher-recruitment platform for Indian schools of every board, built by educators for teachers and the schools that hire them.
about.v1d: Every vacancy states its TET, qualification and board requirements, and applicants are checked against them, so eligibility is clear before anyone applies.
about.v2d: Teachers see why they match a vacancy, point by point; no black-box scores.
about.v3d: Verified schools, child-safety declarations and data rights under the DPDP Act, 2023.
about.contactText: Questions about vacancies, school subscriptions, partnerships or your data? Write to us.
